entities.definition: Default-off operator request to admit eligible export during a current qualifying AEMO price interval through the existing automatic export owner and protection policy. This request does not establish retailer event provenance or payment.
entities.unit_and_sign: No unit; on requests eligible price-triggered export and off withdraws it
entities.time_basis: Current saved configuration; admission requires a fresh matching price interval
entities.availability: Configuration remains available independently of monitor and electrical feedback; normal commissioning, ownership and Safety Lock gates remain binding on hardware commands

fleet_summary_v1.export_authority_source: Export-session authority: zerohero for the retained scheduled policy or price for the current persisted price interval; this does not identify an external VPP writer.
fleet_summary_v1.export_price_deadline: Aware ISO timestamp of the retained price interval deadline, or null for ordinary ZEROHERO authority; software enforcement requires Home Assistant and actuator liveness.

orchestrator_status_v1.export_price_deadline: Aware ISO timestamp of the retained price interval deadline, or null for ordinary ZEROHERO authority; software enforcement requires Home Assistant and actuator liveness.
orchestrator_status_v1.price_triggered_export_enabled: Saved default-off eligibility request for price-triggered export; true does not by itself authorize a hardware command.
